findings.finding: Bodily activity and multisensory experience cause embodied changes that become an automatic part of expertise.
findings.quote: It illustrates how multisensory experience causes embodied changes that become an automatic part of physician expertise.

findings.finding: Kinesthetic learning is defined as the process that results in new knowledge through the involvement of body movement.
findings.quote: She defined kinesthetic learning as the process that results in new knowledge (or understanding) with the involvement of the learner's body movement.

findings.finding: Skill memories are acquired through direct demonstration and require several repetitions.
findings.quote: Skill memories are difficult to convey except by direct demonstration, may be acquired without awareness, and require several repetitions.

findings.finding: Interventions that include higher levels of bodily embodiment can significantly increase learner engagement and learning gains.
findings.quote: Results demonstrated that the three groups that included embodiment learned significantly more than the symbols and text group on the traditional keyboard post-test.

principle: Emodied learning relies on physical activity, multisensory experience, and bodily engagement to help learners build new skills and patterns of acting.
for_the_teacher: Use direct physical demonstration paired with multiple repetitions to help learners build skill memories.
Involve whole-body movements and active bodily engagement to support kinesthetic processing during lessons.
when_it_does_not_apply: Scientific studies do not support the claim that using a kinesthetic modality improves learning specifically in students who merely identify kinesthetic learning as their preferred learning style.
